title: aim
description: What the orchestrator gives `steering aim` on stdin, for it to take into the steering: the work's opportunity solution tree, its tasks, and its decisions, each whole as the orchestrator weighed them. A task that the steering already holds at the same path keeps where it is on its way, unless the aim says what it takes next.

tasks.description: What's left to do for the target solution, in the order the tasks are worked. A task that the steering holds and the aim leaves out is canceled.

id.description: The task's id, as the steering holds it, for a task it holds; absent for a new task, which `steering aim` gives the next id.

next.description: Where the weighing decides what the task takes next: generator, to make it again on what was weighed, within LIMIT evaluated Rounds; fixer, to mend it; refactorer, to refactor it. Absent, it goes on as the steering holds it. To make it again from its first Round, as the solution it was made on changed, leave it out and give a new task.
